policy: No image was auto-ingested into Sanity for this pilot. An item is only eligible for automatic ingestion once ALL three are true: (1) the source explicitly permits editorial reuse, (2) the exact required credit/photographer is known, (3) the intended use complies with the source's terms. None of the candidates below currently satisfy all three with full confidence, so every item is 'permission_required' or 'placeholder_only'. See README.md for the full reasoning per source.

items.credit: Visit Estonia / Enterprise Estonia (EAS) — specific photographer to be confirmed per asset
items.notes: Visit Estonia's media centre states assets 'can be used to promote Estonia' with required credit to author + Visit Estonia, but forbids use 'in advertising campaigns and marketing activities that are directed to sell a certain product or service'. Given AROUND's Trip/booking features, confirm applicability with brand@estonia.ee before use, and pick one concrete asset with its named photographer before ingesting. Most promising path of all five sources for a fast, real clearance.

The Manifest is AROUND's own editorial voice piece, not tied to one operator's property. Recommend original AROUND photography (matching the credit convention already used for Reit im Winkl, e.g. 'Tobias Hennecke') rather than sourcing third-party imagery for the flagship brand piece. No external candidate is proposed here on purpose.
